svg.text: code-server on EC2 vs Lambda MicroVMs
The same VS Code in the browser on two compute models, each with Claude Code wired to Amazon Bedrock
EC2 variant: always-on, CloudFront in front
Lambda MicroVMs variant: on demand, token-authenticated endpoint
